correctness.rationale: The 35 candidate triples on seven coordinates produce 595 unordered distinct-word sums and 630 distinct forbidden quadruples of triples from collisions; equal-sum input pairs cannot share one triple. Every feasible code is exactly an independent set avoiding all 630 four-hyperedges. A 7-cap on each coordinate degree follows from the C4-free link graph on the other six vertices (sharp edge extremum 7). The inspected C++ exhaustive branch-and-bound enumerates all completions containing fixed {0,1,2}, which is without loss for codebooks >=14 under S7 symmetry; pruning excludes only forced conflicts and tight link degrees. Independent separately implemented C++ complete search found no 15-word solution, 48 size-14 solutions through the fixed triple, all 2-(7,3,2), and generated 630 conflicts (independent search-node counts differ because branching differs). Direct cyclic witness has 14 sums-unique triples; 35*48/14=120 labeled optima and its S7 orbit has size 120, hence single orbit and double-Fano classification. The result is an exhaustive finite certificate for exactly n=7,k=3, distinct pairs, not a general extremal theorem.
